overview.en: Neopetalia punctata is a dragonfly in the distinctive South American family Neopetaliidae.
overview.fr: Neopetalia punctata est une libellule de la famille sud-américaine singulière des Neopetaliidae.

identification.en: It is the sole living representative of its family; its larva helped clarify that it is not an aeshnoid dragonfly.
identification.fr: C’est le seul représentant vivant de sa famille ; sa larve a contribué à établir qu’elle n’appartient pas aux Aeshnoidea.

habitat.en: Published accounts associate it with temperate streams in Chile and Argentina.
habitat.fr: Les publications associent l’espèce aux cours d’eau tempérés du Chili et d’Argentine.

diet.en: The references consulted do not provide a species-specific account of its prey.
diet.fr: Les références consultées ne décrivent pas les proies propres à l’espèce.

behavior.en: Its aquatic larva was described in a taxonomic study, but the sources consulted give little detail on adult behavior.
behavior.fr: Sa larve aquatique a été décrite dans une étude taxonomique, mais les sources consultées donnent peu de détails sur le comportement des adultes.

reproduction.en: The larval stage is known, while detailed observations of egg-laying and development were not found in the references consulted.
reproduction.fr: Le stade larvaire est connu, mais les références consultées ne décrivent pas en détail la ponte ni le développement.

ecology.en: This relict lineage is associated with temperate running water in the southern Andes; the extent of its populations is not established by the sources consulted.
ecology.fr: Cette lignée relique est associée aux eaux courantes tempérées des Andes méridionales ; les sources consultées n’établissent pas l’étendue de ses populations.

conservation.en: No species-level conservation category or population trend was established in the sources consulted.
conservation.fr: Les sources consultées n’établissent ni catégorie de conservation ni tendance démographique à l’échelle de l’espèce.

title.en: Critical Species of Odonata in the Neotropics — International Journal of Odonatology
title.fr: Espèces d’Odonates néotropicaux préoccupantes — International Journal of Odonatology

facts: The odonate review lists Neopetalia punctata in Neopetaliidae, associates it with temperate streams in Chile and Argentina, and notes that it has no known close relatives.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: The larva of Neopetalia punctata and establishment of Austropetaliidae — Proceedings of the Entomological Society of Washington
title.fr: La larve de Neopetalia punctata et la création des Austropetaliidae — Proceedings of the Entomological Society of Washington

facts: Carle and Louton described the larva and used it to revise odonate family relationships, establishing Austropetaliidae for other taxa previously grouped with Neopetalia.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: State of knowledge of Chilean Odonata — National Museum of Natural History of Chile
title.fr: État des connaissances sur les Odonates du Chili — Musée national d’histoire naturelle du Chili

facts: The Chilean museum review documents Neopetalia punctata among Chilean Odonata and summarizes the limited state of knowledge of immature stages and distribution in the country's dragonflies.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Species-level biological and conservation information is sparse. A 2004 review reports no close relatives, but phylogenetic relationships among dragonfly families have continued to be revised.
review_note: Cross-checked a Spanish-language Chilean museum review with peer-reviewed odonate taxonomy and larval research. Kept the species account concise because details on adult ecology and conservation were not established.
